acip: GANG THOS PAS SEMS CAN RNAMS KYI LAS KYI SGRIB PA YONGS SU BYANG BAR 'GYUR BA DANG, SLAD MA'I TSE SLAD MA'I DUS SU DAM PA'I CHOS LTAR BCOS PA 'BYUNG BA NA SEMS CAN DE DAG RJES SU GZUNG BA'I SLAD DU, DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA DE DAG GI MTSAN DANG, SNGON GYI SMON LAM KHYAD PAR RGYAS PA BCOM LDAN 'DAS KYIS BSTAN DU GSOL,
wylie: gang thos pas sems can rnams kyi las kyi sgrib pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ba dang, slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus su dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na sems can de dag rjes su gzung ba'i slad du, de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi mtshan dang, sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol
english: O Conqueror, we ask you to elucidate for us the holy names of certain Enlightened Beings Who Have Gone That Way; and the details of the prayers that they made in days gone by. We ask you to do this so that living beings may be completely cleaned of each and every bad deed they have ever done; and in order to guide those beings who will come later, in those future days when false versions of your holy teachings may have spread in the world. Atha Bhagavan Manjushriye Kumarabhutaya sadhukaram adat.
